chapter: Buddy Petit, Kid Thomas and working life
title: Playing with many bands at once while keeping a day job
summary: He might work with four bands in a week and kept a day job as stock cutter in a shoe factory.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you something. How many bands would you be playing with at one time? Say you're playing with one guy, Kid Thomas for example, on the weekends. How many other bands would you be working with during the course of the week? Well, like I know, I'm waiting with Kid Thomas. Weekends would be maybe Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Just anything come along in between that with anybody else, I'd just take it. That would be sometimes two or three nights, you know. You might be working with four bands at once, huh? Sure.
Did you have a day job at this time during these years? Oh yeah. Always, yeah. Always kept a day job. What kind of a day job?
I was, I used to work in a shoe factory. Were you a shoe maker? No. I was a stock cutter in a shoe factory.

And then you'd just play music in the evening? Yeah. Would you take a job at night, say you had to go to your shoe factory job in the daytime? Could you play a music job at night? Oh yeah. I could take it in them beds.
